device_name: CREO 5.5 Small Diameter low profile system
description:
CREO 5.5: Small Diameter low-profile Stabilization system
The CREO 5.5 system is a low-profile thoracolumbar stabilization system designed to accept the 5.5mm rod diameter. It is a non-modular polyaxial head system in titanium with non-threaded locking caps to prevent cross-threading.
